extraction.legacy_note: Acquisition manifest sorted WindowsPath objects case-insensitively; curator sorts relative POSIX strings case-sensitively. The identical 898 files / 105843756 bytes have different valid array-order digests; no source bytes changed.
extraction.manifest_algorithm: Sorted relative POSIX paths with byte sizes and SHA-256; SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON for the full files array with sorted keys, comma/colon separators, ensure_ascii=False and no trailing newline.

manual_reconciliation.note: Primary curator checked factory PDF 119/printed 2-45 lamp,PDF 121/2-47 solenoid andPDF126/2-52 switch drawings against retained topology. Callout circles are never coordinates; below-playfield sensor and absent emitter geometry remain explicit. The relevant drawing bands are retained with hashes and native derivations in manual-topology.md; they are topology cross-checks and do not supply measured scan coordinates.

promotion_decision: The game remains partial. Public address and mechanism inventories are complete, while exact serial LED pin routing, individual emitter/socket geometry and several hidden sensor coordinates remain unresolved. Observed assembly projections retain concrete per-device blockers.
transformation: x/right, y/bottom, rounded with the repository spatial helper to six decimals.

world_mesh.axis_note: OBJ X/Y are retained VPX player-view X/Y; exporter negates vertical Z only. Independent flipper pivots, RopePopper and scoop capture controls reconcile the assembly footprints.
